newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close dull session mixed, July down.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close dull session mixed, July down.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures ended narrowly mixed in rangebound and featureless dealings.
Analysts said the failure of the market to rally could weigh on prices Thursday. But the market could remain in its recent trading range amid a dearth of new fundamental developments.
Firm support basis May was pegged at the recent low of 72.10 cents hit on April 9, and longer-term support cited at 65.50 cents, a low made in 1993.
Most-active July closed 0.15 cent per lb lower at 77.65 cents per lb, having traded from 78.30 to 77.50 cents. May finished up 0.05 cent at 75.75 cents.
Volume was estimated at 5,000 lots compared with Tuesday's official 3,797 lots.
